title: Value of a Tire-Day Alignment in a Cancellation Refund — Alignment Services & Plans
content:
**Clause.** When an Alignment Services & Plans plan is cancelled, an alignment included in the plan and performed on the install date of the vehicle's active Crestline tire set under Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty is valued, in place of the line's deduction per included alignment, at:

- **54.99** when that tire set's tire line includes a complimentary alignment check;
- **89.99** when that tire set's tire line does not include one.

Every other included alignment keeps the line's deduction per included alignment, and so does every alignment when the vehicle has no active Crestline tire set.

### Condition — judgement — result
| Included alignment dated the active tire set's install date | Tire line includes a complimentary alignment check | Value deducted for that alignment |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 54.99 |
| Yes | No | 89.99 |
| No | — | the line's deduction per included alignment |
| (vehicle has no active Crestline tire set) | — | the line's deduction per included alignment |

*Hypothetical:* a plan bought on the day new tires were installed, with its purchase-day alignment on that install date and one later included alignment: the purchase-day alignment is valued at 54.99 or 89.99 according to the tire line, and the later alignment at the line's deduction.
